note: All weights are downloaded on demand; nothing is bundled in the APK. Sizes are the exact byte sizes of the upstream release assets (rounded to the nearest MB) and are used both for the storage pre-flight check and for truncation detection. Fill in "sha256" (or "crc32") for a model to enable strong integrity verification; when both are empty the downloader verifies the byte count only.

models.name: Face Landmarker (478 pt mesh + 52 blendshapes)
models.description: MediaPipe Tasks Face Landmarker, float16. Gives 478 landmarks (468 mesh + 10 iris), 52 ARKit style blendshapes and a 4x4 facial transformation matrix. This is the backbone of pose, expression and occlusion aware swapping.

models.name: SCRFD det_10g + ArcFace r50 (buffalo_l pack)
models.description: InsightFace buffalo_l pack. det_10g.onnx is SCRFD-10GF (multi face boxes + confidence + 5 points), w600k_r50.onnx is the ArcFace R50 recogniser used for source embeddings and the identity score.

models.name: inswapper_128_fp16 (identity transfer)
models.description: The 128x128 face swapper, float16 build (half the size/bandwidth of the fp32 model, identical output). Needs the source ArcFace embedding as its second input.

models.name: BiSeNet face parser (occlusion / region masks)
models.description: 19 class CelebAMask-HQ parser at 512x512. Used to keep hair, glasses, hands and beards on top of the swapped skin and to restrict the colour transfer to skin only.

models.name: GFPGAN v1.4 (hyper realistic detail)
models.description: 512x512 face restoration with an optional fidelity weight input (0..1). We drive it from the Hyper Realistic slider so pores and wrinkles survive instead of being smoothed away.

models.name: Real-ESRGAN x2 fp16 (background / output upscale)
models.description: Tiled 2x super resolution used for the 512/1024/4K export path and to match grain and micro detail of the background when the swap is upscaled.

models.name: NSFW content analyser
models.description: Yahoo open_nsfw at 224x224. Blocks explicit source or target images before any processing happens (safety requirement).
